author: Here for the Wins
title: Only positive is fast payouts
content:
My experience with Cider Casino has been extremely disappointing. I’ve put thousands of dollars into games on this platform and have only won a little over $300. At this point, it feels like the games just take, take, take with very little meaningful return.

The advertised RTP makes my experience even harder to understand. One game in particular, Piggy Bankroll Vault Smash, shows an RTP of approximately 92.7%, but my actual experience playing it has felt nowhere remotely close to that. I understand that RTP is theoretical and calculated over a very large number of spins, so individual results can vary significantly. However, after the amount of money and play I’ve put into this game, the experience has been abysmal.

I typically wager between $5 and $10 and have played consistently since downloading Cider Casino. In Piggy Bankroll Vault Smash, I’ve reached the point where all of my pigs are diamond, meaning I’m essentially waiting on the progressive prizes, yet I have seen nothing substantial come from it. The game just continues taking money.

What makes this especially frustrating is that I play the same or similar games on other platforms and my experience has been dramatically different. I downloaded McLuck and Cider Casino around the same time, and I won more than $5,000 playing on McLuck. I’ve also played Piggy Bankroll Vault Smash on Jackpot Go and had considerably more success there. I understand that past wins on another platform don’t guarantee future results, but the difference in my personal experience has been striking.

I also think Cider needs to be much clearer about its new-player “risk-free” promotion. The promotion I received indicated that if a new player lost $777 within 24 hours, the amount would be returned risk-free. What was not sufficiently clear to me upfront was that the promotional amount would be rationed out over SEVEN DAYS rather than simply returned at once. That is an extremely important condition and should be prominently disclosed when advertising an offer as “risk-free.” Had I understood that clearly beforehand, it absolutely would have affected how I viewed the promotion.

The one thing I will give Cider Casino credit for is payout speed. When you actually have something available to redeem, they pay quickly. Unfortunately, fast payouts don’t mean much when my overall experience has been overwhelmingly losing.

Based on my experience, I cannot recommend Cider Casino. Between the extremely poor results I’ve experienced, my concerns about how the promotional terms were presented, and the huge difference between my experience here and on other platforms, I won’t continue putting thousands of dollars into games that have given me virtually nothing back.

If you’re considering playing here, read every promotional condition carefully, understand that advertised RTP does not guarantee what any individual player will receive, and keep very close track of exactly how much you deposit, wager, win, and redeem.
